title: Machine-learning-based models for the optimization of post-cervical spinal laminoplasty outpatient follow-up schedules.
summary: LSTM predicts a defined 24-month PASS outcome from postoperative records with a prospective internal test set; small single-center cohort limits generalization.
ai_technology: 80 cervical laminoplasty patients; eight algorithms predict PASS (JOA ≥14.25) at 24 months from data through 12 months; LSTM AUROC .90±.13, prospective internal test AUROC .858±.007. No external cohort.
